compatibilityRules: Research artifacts remain readable independently of canon state.
PENDING records must not be emitted as approved visual canon.
Approved records must retain source provenance and selected geometry reference.
Rejected or deferred alternatives remain historical evidence.
Hybrid decisions require explicit per-glyph or family mapping.
Retraced records return to research and do not silently promote.
GPT + GitHub remain sufficient for this pipeline.
